integrity: Finite enumerations verify small cases; the proof is analytic for all integers m>=2. Novelty has residual unindexed-prior risk and no independently performed audit.
scientific_limitations: Equal unit edge weights, one sink, addition at its uniquely matched nonneighbor, and uniform recurrent starting configuration only; no full avalanche polynomial or other drives established.
title: A double-toppling extreme avalanche on cocktail-party graphs
